title: Black Bottle Product Reel
tests: Tests turning an attached product photo into one coherent 15-second vertical ad while preserving product identity.

faults.what: The required “Shop now” call to action is absent from the supplied ending frame.
The lid changes from the reference's compact upright handle to a larger, rounded loop in the close-up and ending views, compromising product fidelity and consistency.
The soundtrack includes the spoken line “The season is changing”, contrary to the explicit no-talking requirement.

judge.summary: A 15-second vertical studio bottle ad provides varied close-ups, but incorrect opening text, an absent closing CTA, an altered lid, and unwanted speech make it unsuitable as delivered.

must_haves.item: One playable 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds, not just a single clip of 10 seconds or less.
must_haves.why: The supplied output is one 15-second MP4 with vertical, approximately 9:16 frames.

must_haves.item: The featured product matches the supplied matte black bottle, including its silhouette and lid.
must_haves.why: The black body broadly resembles the reference, but the lid handle becomes a substantially different rounded loop.

must_haves.item: The ad includes multiple moving product views or close-ups in a clean studio setting.
must_haves.why: The sampled sequence shows full-product framing, a lid close-up, a lower-body close-up, and a return to a full view against a clean neutral studio background.

must_haves.item: The opening reads exactly “Your everyday bottle” and the ending reads exactly “Shop now”.
must_haves.why: The opening reads “Your eveyady bottle”, and no “Shop now” text is visible in the supplied ending frame.

must_haves.item: Mellow music is audible and there is no spoken voice.
must_haves.why: The audio report explicitly identifies speech saying “The season is changing”; the music's presence and mood cannot be established from the supplied transcription.
